description:
Household and family make-up: lone-person, family and group households, household size, couples with and without children and one-parent families, for every suburb and council area.

Coverage: About 10,600 suburbs and localities and 545 council areas across Australia, in all states and territories (areas with too few residents for reliable figures are left out); one snapshot at 10 August 2021. Current to 2021-08-10. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/households`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: total_households, total_families, family_households_count, family_households_pct, non_family_households_count, non_family_households_pct, lone_person_households_count, lone_person_households_pct, size_1_person_count, size_1_person_pct, size_2_people_count, size_2_people_pct, size_3_people_count, size_3_people_pct, size_4_people_count, size_4_people_pct, size_5_people_count, size_5_people_pct, size_6_plus_people_count, size_6_plus_people_pct, couple_no_children_count, couple_no_children_pct, couple_with_children_count, couple_with_children_pct, one_parent_families_count, one_parent_families_pct, other_families_count, other_families_pct, couple_children_under_15_count, couple_children_under_15_pct, one_parent_children_under_15_count, one_parent_children_under_15_pct, couple_families_count, couple_families_pct. Omit for all.

suburb_name.description: Suburb name exactly as /v1/suburbs/list returns it, e.g. `Bondi` or `St Kilda (Vic.)`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.

name: suburbs_area_stats_households
title: Suburb · Households and families
